finding: Sleep duration of >8 hr/day before pregnancy and experiencing a decrease in mid-pregnancy was a risk factor for Caesarean section and medically indicated Caesarean section, while sitting ≥8 hr/weekday in pre-, mid- and late pregnancy had a protective effect for Caesarean section and medically indicated Caesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that sleep duration of >8 hours/day before pregnancy and experiencing a decrease in mid-pregnancy was a risk factor for Cesarean section, while sitting for 8 or more hours a day had a protective effect.
